column1: # What an NPC says when the player presses X at it (Gateway/NpcTalk.cs), from Sanctuary (OSFR): a quest giver says its first
# quest's offer (Resources/Quests.json GiverDialogueId), a talk goal's NPC its goal dialogue (DialogueId or Dialogue lines), and
# the three NPCs with a greeting script (Scripts/Npc) their greeting. Columns: npc id, kind (offer, goal, greeting), quest id,
# lines (text id/response text id, comma-separated; response 0 = the generic "You got it!").
